parsed.rationale: Both participating records live under test file paths — `Shared/Metadata/Tests/MetadataTests/PlaycutMetadataServiceCachingTests.swift` and `Shared/Metadata/Tests/MetadataTests/DiscogsAPIEntityResolverCachingTests.swift` — making them test fixtures by location even though the `is_test` flag is recorded as false. The types `MetadataMockWebSession` and `EntityResolverMockWebSession` are type-alias objects with no declared fields, suggesting they are lightweight local stubs scoped to their respective test files. Merging them into a shared helper would couple two independent test suites and risk obscuring the distinct intent each alias encodes for its own caching test scenario.
